overview: Live terminal dashboard for server monitoring — CPU, memory, swap, disk I/O, network, TLS certificate expiry, and K3s pod alerts. htop-style interface with auto-refresh. Press q to quit.
prerequisites: SSH or console access to the server

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-server-status

steps.title: Launch dashboard
steps.body: Opens a full-screen live dashboard. Press q or Ctrl+C to exit.

steps.title: JSON snapshot (for scripts)
steps.body: One-shot metrics export — useful for monitoring integrations.

commands.description: Override refresh interval for one session

notes: Shows K3s pod warnings when cluster is unhealthy
Checks TLS expiry for configured ingress hostnames
Does not require sudo to run the dashboard
